title: Hi, I'm Mahin 👋
body:
# Hi, I'm Mahin 👋
Brand Marketing & Strategy Professional · Dhaka, Bangladesh

I led Pureit’s logo rollout across seven-plus touchpoints as it moved from Unilever to A. O. Smith. At X Integrated, I managed customer engagement for five client accounts. Today, I co-run an agency producing short-form content for Lux, Lifebuoy and Dove.

## At a glance
- 10+ brands worked with across FMCG, consumer durables and fintech
- Pureit brand transition (Unilever → A. O. Smith), via BizLearner
- 7 competition podiums, incl. 3 championships, plus a Marico finalist spot
